framework_lessons: Match liability duration to cash generation.
assessment: Strongest on issuer mechanics: long fixed debt, cash coverage and ET credit improvement are supported. The five-year equity theses are still open. Macro recession expectations failed, and the claim that a major Bitcoin advance needed a rising PMI was too restrictive. Custodia discussion understates the regulator’s stated operational concerns, and the three-pillar portfolio needs explicit weights before an aggregate score is meaningful.
